abstract: Glassdoor Economic Research analyzes whether the AI job market represents genuine growth or hype by examining compensation premiums and job listing trends. The analysis finds that AI-focused positions command a 25% salary premium compared to similar non-AI roles, and AI job listings nearly doubled year-over-year from 2023 to 2024, suggesting significant market expansion in AI employment opportunities.
keyFindings: AI jobs offer a typical salary premium of 25% compared to similar non-AI positions.
The share of AI jobs among new job listings increased 123% from 2023 to 2024.
methodology: Analysis of Glassdoor job listing data comparing compensation levels and job posting trends between AI-focused and non-AI positions. Specific sample size, geographic scope, and job categories not specified in available excerpt.
